description: Header file implementing NEON-based packing and unpacking functions for IQ samples with specific bit widths (9, 14, 16 bits) in a wireless communication context.

methods.name: pack_neon_register_9b_big_endian
methods.description: Reads 8 16-bit IQ values from NEON register and packs into 9 bytes in big-endian format.

methods.name: pack_prb_9b_big_endian
methods.description: Compresses 16-bit IQ samples to 9 bits per sample and stores in buffer.

methods.name: pack_neon_register_14b_big_endian
methods.description: Reads 8 16-bit IQ values and packs into 14 bytes in big-endian format.

methods.name: pack_prb_14b_big_endian
methods.description: Compresses IQ samples to 14 bits and stores in buffer.

methods.name: pack_prb_16b_big_endian
methods.description: Packs 16-bit IQ samples into 48 bytes buffer.

methods.name: unpack_prb_9b_big_endian
methods.description: Unpacks 9-bit packed IQ samples from bytes into 16-bit signed values.

methods.name: unpack_prb_14b_big_endian
methods.description: Unpacks 14-bit packed IQ samples into 16-bit signed values.

methods.name: unpack_prb_16b_big_endian
methods.description: Unpacks 16-bit IQ samples from bytes into 16-bit signed values.

methods.name: unpack_compressed_14bit_values
methods.description: Converts 14-bit compressed data in NEON register to 16-bit signed IQ values.

methods.name: unpack_prb_big_endian
methods.description: Dispatches to specific unpacking function based on IQ width.

methods.name: iq_width_packing_supported
methods.description: Checks if given IQ bit width (9, 14, 16) is supported.
